SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS mismatched_combos,
  SUM(f.weekly_forecast) AS total_orphaned_forecast_dollars,
  MIN(COALESCE(a.QGP_Week, f.QGP_Week)) AS earliest_week,
  MAX(COALESCE(a.QGP_Week, f.QGP_Week)) AS latest_week
FROM `prj-dbi-prd-1.ds_dbi_digitalmedia_automation.sdi_mfc_bronze_spendActualsGranular_weekly` a
FULL OUTER JOIN `prj-dbi-prd-1.ds_dbi_digitalmedia_automation.sdi_mfc_bronze_spendForecastGranular_weekly` f
  ON a.QGP_Week = f.QGP_Week AND a.LOB_Supported = f.LOB_Supported
 AND a.Channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Channel AND a.Tactic IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Tactic
 AND a.Message_Type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Message_Type AND a.Agency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Agency
WHERE a.Quarter IS NOT NULL AND f.Quarter IS NOT NULL AND a.Quarter != f.Quarter;

output:
mismatched_combos	total_orphaned_forecast_dollars	earliest_week	latest_week
828	180113042.73807502	2022-12-31	2026-07-04


SELECT
  a.LOB_Supported,
  a.Quarter AS Actual_Quarter,
  f.Quarter AS Forecast_Quarter,
  COUNT(*) AS n_combos,
  SUM(f.weekly_forecast) AS orphaned_forecast_dollars
FROM `prj-dbi-prd-1.ds_dbi_digitalmedia_automation.sdi_mfc_bronze_spendActualsGranular_weekly` a
FULL OUTER JOIN `prj-dbi-prd-1.ds_dbi_digitalmedia_automation.sdi_mfc_bronze_spendForecastGranular_weekly` f
  ON a.QGP_Week = f.QGP_Week AND a.LOB_Supported = f.LOB_Supported
 AND a.Channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Channel AND a.Tactic IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Tactic
 AND a.Message_Type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Message_Type AND a.Agency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Agency
WHERE a.Quarter IS NOT NULL AND f.Quarter IS NOT NULL AND a.Quarter != f.Quarter
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY orphaned_forecast_dollars DESC;

SELECT
  COALESCE(a.QGP_Week, f.QGP_Week) AS QGP_Week,
  a.LOB_Supported,
  a.Quarter AS Actual_Quarter, f.Quarter AS Forecast_Quarter,
  a.weekly_actual, f.weekly_forecast
FROM `prj-dbi-prd-1.ds_dbi_digitalmedia_automation.sdi_mfc_bronze_spendActualsGranular_weekly` a
FULL OUTER JOIN `prj-dbi-prd-1.ds_dbi_digitalmedia_automation.sdi_mfc_bronze_spendForecastGranular_weekly` f
  ON a.QGP_Week = f.QGP_Week AND a.LOB_Supported = f.LOB_Supported
 AND a.Channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Channel AND a.Tactic IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Tactic
 AND a.Message_Type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Message_Type AND a.Agency IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.Agency
WHERE a.Quarter IS NOT NULL AND f.Quarter IS NOT NULL AND a.Quarter != f.Quarter
  AND COALESCE(a.QGP_Week, f.QGP_Week) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
ORDER BY QGP_Week DESC;
